**bin/ideate-to-consus.mjs** — Added a header comment (right after the shebang, before the existing purpose comment) stating it's a separate, optional, Consus/Janus-dependent integration utility excluded from Minerva's "genuinely standalone" claim, and referencing the rip-out commit `8b450e0`. Confirmed via `git diff` that the change is purely additive comment lines — no logic touched.

**README.md, VISION.md, .pHive/CONTEXT.md, .pHive/project-profile.yaml** — Reviewed. Their Consus/Delphi mentions describe the future v2 decision-surface wiring (forward-looking "Goals" language), not the removed poll methods. No dead flags, no stale references. Confirmed already accurate — no edits made, per the story's explicit "confirm, don't rewrite" scoping.
